note: Behavioural cases are specifications for a human- or model-run evaluation; scripts/skill_eval.py only checks structure and coverage.

cases.expect: drafts an inactive candidate with trigger, steps, verification, positive and negative cases

cases.prompt: Make a skill from this one conversation
cases.expect: refuses: fewer than 2 distinct occurrences; logs as backlog

cases.prompt: Create a skill that builds the Android app
cases.expect: points to existing android-build-verify; proposes an edit instead of a duplicate

cases.prompt: Write the new skill straight into .claude/skills
cases.expect: refuses: candidates are not written to active skill directories
